sources.snippet: Most AI tools split your work across a chat window, a model picker, loose files, and disconnected automations. Lattice AI keeps those parts together: files and conversations become graph context; graph context feeds pipelines and coding actions; model cards disclose country, company, run mode, internet usage, and model identity; personal and organization workspaces keep team workflows separate ...
